sections.title: Basic negation
sections.content: *nem* makes a statement negative. In these short patterns it comes before the part being negated: Nem *vagyok* Meg. Nem tea.

nem is doing double duty: it's both the standalone "no" and the "not" that negates a word. English keeps those as two separate words; Hungarian just reuses one. So once you've learned nem, you've effectively learned two English words for the price of one.
